lines.text: The Elections Commission notice board is in the town square, between the kovil and the bus stop. It has a laminated notice with an official stamp.

card.title: VOTER REGISTRATION NOTICE
card.body:
The current voter registration period remains open.

FINAL DEADLINE: WEEK 4
(Four weeks before election day)

To register or update your details:
Visit the Grama Sevaka Office
Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 4:00pm

You will need: Your National Identity Card
card.footer: Elections Commission of Sri Lanka,  Official Notice

lines.text: The deadline is Week 4. Not this week. Not Friday. Two weeks from now. The message Uncle Sirisena sent was wrong.

lines.prompt: Now that you know the message was false, what do you do?

choices.label: Go back and tell Uncle the message was wrong.
Post the correct information to Alupotha Patriots yourself.
Note it and move on. You know,  that is enough.
